annotations.title: Find parking by name or road

description: Car parks and on-street parking whose name, address or road contains a keyword, with free spaces right now. Example: city "Taipei", keyword "市府"; or keyword "復興北路".

city.description: City: a TDX code (Taipei, NewTaipei, Taoyuan, Taichung, Tainan, Kaohsiung, Keelung, Hsinchu, HsinchuCounty, MiaoliCounty, ChanghuaCounty, NantouCounty, YunlinCounty, Chiayi, ChiayiCounty, PingtungCounty, YilanCounty, HualienCounty, TaitungCounty, KinmenCounty, PenghuCounty, LienchiangCounty) or its Chinese name (臺北市, 新北市, 高雄市, ...).

keyword.description: Part of the name, address or road, e.g. "府前廣場" or "忠孝東路".

limit.description: Maximum number of places to return (default 10).

vehicle.description: Spaces for a "car" (default) or a "scooter" (機車).

want.description: "space": leave out places known to be full or closed (places without live data stay in); "any": every place. Default "any".

name: parking_search
title: Find parking by name or road
